viewing_check: Check the shrink wrap and tape seals on all sides and underside, whether the right-edge tear has opened the box, any sign of resealing, and whether the box is sealed or just a box. Shake gently for rattling. Photograph the back and base. If opened or unsealed, value drops to about A$100-140 (open complete sets sell far lower; built complete no box about US$70-85).
